description:
Kromed is a medical operations platform for teams that provide external respiratory and home-care services. The business problem is that scheduling, patient follow-up, collaborator coordination, visit validation, clinical notes, supplies, equipment rentals, payments, and collaborator payouts are often handled across WhatsApp, spreadsheets, PDFs, and manual reminders. That creates conflicts, missing information, delayed collections, unclear payouts, and poor operational visibility.

Kromed centralizes that workflow into a role-based web platform. Leaders manage patients, collaborators, schedules, visits, inventory, payments, payouts, and operational dashboards. Collaborators see their assigned visits, patients, availability, reschedule requests, clinical notes, and payment-related information. The system uses Supabase as the source of truth and keeps patient, clinical, scheduling, and financial data protected with role checks and database-level access rules.

## Core Technologies and Concepts Used

* Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, and TypeScript for the web app.
* Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui with Lucide icons for the production UI.
* Supabase Auth, Supabase Postgres, RLS policies, and Supabase SSR/client helpers for identity, database access, and protected data.
* Supabase schema covering profiles, collaborators, patients, assignments, clinical parameters, visits, availability, inventory, equipment, payments, payouts, audit events, automation runs, conversations, and messages.
* n8n for AI and workflow automation. I verified the live n8n workspace through the API: it has Kromed workflows for the inbound WhatsApp agent, AI Supabase tool agent, Supabase context tool, business operations tool, inbound agent test suite, voice-note transcription, Zavu smoke tests, reminders, and visit digests.
* OpenAI through n8n LangChain agent nodes for AI-assisted operational interpretation, with deterministic n8n tool workflows handling real business actions.
* Zavu for WhatsApp inbound and outbound messaging.
* ElevenLabs Speech-to-Text for WhatsApp voice-note transcription.
* Playwright, ESLint, and Next.js build checks for UI and implementation verification.

At a concept level, Kromed combines role-based healthcare operations, Supabase-backed data integrity, WhatsApp automation, AI-assisted workflow routing, auditability, and human-controlled clinical/financial decisions.

Trapiche Lab es una plataforma web de laboratorios interactivos de física (escalable a diferentes temas) que convierte la teoría de los libros en simulaciones manipulables, visuales y explicadas por voz en tiempo real. El nombre viene del trapiche: así como muele la caña para hacerla aprovechable, la plataforma "muele" fórmulas y fenómenos complejos en experiencias que el estudiante puede tocar y entender.

El problema: la física se aprende de forma pasiva (libros y fórmulas aisladas), y las IA genéricas empeoran esto porque inventan resultados, dan respuestas demasiado generales y fomentan copiar en lugar de experimentar.

La solución: el estudiante aprende experimentando. Modifica parámetros (masas, ángulos, densidades, cargas), arrastra objetos, ve fuerzas y trayectorias, analiza gráficas, compara intentos y pregunta por voz.

Los 3 diferenciadores clave:

Cero alucinaciones científicas: motores deterministas en TypeScript hacen todos los cálculos; la IA solo explica valores ya calculados, nunca los inventa.
Motor pedagógico por eventos: detecta fenómenos educativos , les asigna una importancia y decide si callar, mostrar texto o hablar, sin resultar molesta, con un flujo de n8n por detras que crea la base de conocimiento indexada al agente.
Tutora de voz con herramientas controladas: "Gissi" (ElevenLabs) solo actúa sobre la escena mediante herramientas autorizadas (highlightElement, focusGraph, showFormula, etc.).
Alcance: 7+ simuladores en 3 categorías (fluidos, cinemática, electromagnetismo); MVP profundo en Arquímedes, Tiro parabólico y Cargas eléctricas.
